note: Alberta Parks recreation area campground on the Forestry Trunk Road, 13 km west of Cochrane on Hwy 1A and 52 km north on Hwy 40, run by Red Rock Sawmills. Sites in the pines with fire pits and picnic tables; free firewood. The hand pump is for putting out fires only, so bring drinking water. The campground connects to the Fallen Timber OHV trail system and riders may leave from their sites; it also has an OHV staging area and free snowmobile staging. --Claude
